current_article.title: Meet notable Trainers during Pokémon GO Fest 2024 in Madrid and New York City
current_article.text:
Updates
Meet notable Trainers during Pokémon GO Fest 2024 in Madrid and New York City
Trainers,
We’re excited to announce some special guests who you can meet at Pokémon GO Fest 2024: Madrid and Pokémon GO Fest 2024: New York City !
Trainers attending the Pokémon GO Fest 2024 events in Madrid and New York City will be able to meet some of these notable Trainers from the community, including ZoëTwoDots , The Trainer Club , Landoralpha , Newtiteuf , Kriket 23 , Keibron Gamer , JTGily , and Swaggron333 !
Meet-and-greets with notable Trainers will take place on all three days of Pokémon GO Fest 2024 in Madrid and New York City. Each notable Trainer will have a designated daily time slot during either the morning or the afternoon where you can meet with your favorite guest to get autographs from and take photos with.
Tickets for Pokémon GO Fest 2024: Madrid and Pokémon GO Fest 2024: New York City are on sale now while supplies last.
Pokémon GO Fest 2024: Madrid meet-and-greet details
Meet-and-greets with notable Trainers will happen during every park session of Pokémon GO Fest 2024: Madrid from June 14 to June 16, 2024. Each notable Trainer will only be available during either the morning park session or the afternoon park session. Lines may be capped early if necessary.
Trainers who do not have a ticket for Pokémon GO Fest 2024: Madrid on the day that a notable Trainer is appearing cannot participate in meet-and-greet activities.

The schedule will be as follows for each day of the event.

Pokémon GO Fest 2024: New York City meet-and-greet details
Meet-and-greets with notable Trainers will happen during every park session of Pokémon GO Fest 2024: New York City from July 5 to July 7, 2024. Each notable Trainer will only be available during either the morning park session or the afternoon park session. Lines may be capped early if necessary.
Trainers who do not have a ticket for Pokémon GO Fest: New York City on the day that a notable Trainer is appearing cannot participate in meet-and-greet activities.

Please be aware of your surroundings and follow guidelines from local health authorities when playing Pokémon GO. Upcoming events are subject to change. Be sure to follow us on social media, opt in to receiving push notifications, and subscribe to our emails to stay updated.
**—The Pokémon GO team**
